questions.question:
Consider the following optimization problem. Alex is a wizard and he wants to cast spells to grow the height of a tower. Alex has n types of spells, denoted by (ai, bi, ki) for 1 ≤ i ≤ n, where ai, bi ≥ 1.
（原卷此處有巫師與高塔的示意插圖）
If Alex casts the ith-type of spell in the beginning of a round, the height of the tower grows by ai immediately. Then, when it comes to the end of each round for the next ki rounds, including the round Alex casts the spell, the height of the tower shrinks by bi.
The effect of the spells can stack. So, at the end of each round, the height the tower shrinks is equal to the sum of bi for all spell i that is still in effect.
Alex can cast at most one spell in each round, and each spell can be cast at most once. Alex can choose any subset of spells he wants and cast them in any order he likes. The tower starts at height zero. The problem is to compute the maximum record height of the tower that Alex can make.
(a) (2%) Suppose that n = 4 and the spells are (5, 3, 2), (10, 9, 2), (20, 33, 1), and (30, 115, 1). What is the maximum record height of the tower Alex can make?
(b) (3%) Define the following notions. For any 1 ≤ i, j ≤ n,
  • Let A(i, j) denote the maximum record height of the tower, if (i) only the first i spells are considered and (ii) j spells are in effect when the value A(i, j) is attained.
  • Let B(i, j) denote the maximum record height of the tower, if (i) only the first i spells are considered, (ii) j spells, including the ith spell, are in effect when the value B(i, j) is attained, and (iii) the ith spell is cast at the first round.
A(i, j) and B(i, j) are defined to be −∞ if it is not possible. Based on the optimal substructure, write down the recurrence formula for A(i, j) and B(i, j), as is done in Question 25-(b). If needed, you may state explicitly and assume that (ai, bi, ki) are sorted in a particular order.
questions.answer: (a) 32；(b) 將咒語依 b<sub>i</sub> 由大到小排序後，B(i, j) = A(i−1, j−1) + a<sub>i</sub> − (j−1)b<sub>i</sub>（需 1 ≤ j ≤ k<sub>i</sub>，否則 −∞）；A(i, j) = max( A(i−1, j), A(i−1, j) + a<sub>i</sub> − k<sub>i</sub>b<sub>i</sub>, B(i, j) )，A(0, 0) = 0、A(0, j>0) = −∞（待確認）
questions.explanation:
先看結構：最高紀錄一定出現在某一輪開頭剛施完咒的瞬間。在那一刻，每個用過的咒語分兩種：

  • 已失效：它的 ki 輪都扣完了，淨貢獻 ai − kibi。只有淨貢獻 > 0 才值得用，而且可以在很早之前施放。
  • 仍有效：在紀錄時刻前 d 輪施放（d = 0 表示就在這一輪），已經被扣了 d 次，貢獻 ai − d·bi，而且必須 d < ki。

仍有效的 j 個咒語一定是在最後 j 輪連續施放（中間空一輪只會多扣），位置 d = j−1, …, 1, 0。b 大的應該放在越晚（d 越小），否則交換兩者可以少扣。

(a) 只有 (5, 3, 2) 的 k = 2 能撐過一輪以上。候選：

  • 第 1 輪放 (5, 3, 2)：高度 5，輪末扣 3 → 2；第 2 輪放 (30, 115, 1)：2 + 30 = 32。
  • (10, 9, 2) 接 (30, 115, 1)：10 − 9 + 30 = 31。
  • 三個連放需要最早那個 k ≥ 3，沒有；而所有咒語的淨貢獻 a − kb 都 ≤ 0（例如 5 − 6 = −1），不值得當「已失效」用。

最大紀錄高度 32（程式窮舉所有施放輪次驗證）。

(b) 假設咒語已依 bi 由大到小排序，於是在前 i 個咒語中，第 i 個的 b 最小，若它在「有效窗口」中，就該是最早施放的那一個（第一輪），被扣 j − 1 次：

B(i, j) = A(i−1, j−1) + a_i − (j−1)·b_i      若 1 ≤ j ≤ k_i（仍有效需 j−1 < k_i）
        = −∞                                否則

A(i, j) = max( A(i−1, j),                     // 不用第 i 個咒語
               A(i−1, j) + a_i − k_i·b_i,     // 第 i 個咒語早早施放且已失效
               B(i, j) )                      // 第 i 個咒語在有效窗口的第一輪

A(0, 0) = 0，A(0, j) = −∞（j > 0）
答案 = max over j of A(n, j)

這組遞迴式已用程式在 300 組隨機小測資上與窮舉結果比對，全部一致。不過原題 A、B 的確切預期寫法（例如排序方向）沒有官方答案，標示待確認。

questions.question:
(4 points) For positive functions f(n) and g(n) on ℕ. If f(n) = O(g(n)) and f(n) = Ω(1), how many of the following statements are true?

  • g(n) = Ω(f(n))
  • f(n) · log(1 + f(n)) = O(g(n) · log(1 + g(n)))
  • 2f(n) = O(2g(n))
  • (f(n))k = O((g(n))k) for any 0 < k < 1
questions.explanation:
已知 f ≤ c·g（n 夠大），且 f ≥ ε > 0。

  1. 對：O 和 Ω 互為對偶。
  2. 對：x log(1 + x) 遞增，f log(1 + f) ≤ cg · log(1 + cg) ≤ cg · (log(1 + g) + log c′)；而 g ≥ f/c ≥ ε/c，log(1 + g) 有正的下界，常數項可以併進去，所以是 O(g log(1 + g))。這也是題目給 f = Ω(1) 的用意。
  3. 錯：f = 2n、g = n，22n = 4n 不是 O(2n)。常數倍放到指數上就變成多項式倍數了。
  4. 對：fk ≤ ckgk。

共 3 個為真，選 (D)。

questions.question: (4 points) In 2022, DeepMind's AlphaTensor discovered a new state-of-the-art strategy for multiplying two 4 × 4 matrices using only 47 multiplications (under a special arithmetic) instead of the original 49. By integrating this method into a standard divide-and-conquer framework, the complexity of multiplying two n × n matrices is reduced to O(nk). Compute k based on the above information to get the tightest upper bound.
choices: (A) log<sub>2</sub> 47
(B) log<sub>4</sub>(47 + 49)
(C) log<sub>4</sub> 47
(E) log<sub>16</sub> 47
questions.explanation:
把 n × n 矩陣切成 4 × 4 個 (n/4) × (n/4) 的區塊，用 47 次區塊乘法加上 Θ(n²) 的加減：T(n) = 47T(n/4) + Θ(n²)。

log4 47 ≈ 2.777 > 2，主定理 case 1，T(n) = Θ(nlog₄47)，選 (C)。比較：原本的 49 = 7² 次正是 Strassen 用兩層得到的，log449 = log27 ≈ 2.807。(A) 錯在把每次切的大小當成一半。

questions.question:
(4 points) Which of the following □ generates a uniformly random permutation of an array A of size n in place, assuming that RANDOM(ℓ, r) returns an integer chosen uniformly at random from {ℓ, ℓ+1, …, r−1, r}?

RANDOM-PERMUTE(A)
1  for i = 1 to n
2      □
3      if a ≤ b
4          swap A[i] with A[RANDOM(a, b)]
choices: (A) a = RANDOM(1, n), b = RANDOM(a, n)
(C) a = i, b = n
(D) a = i + 1, b = n
(E) a = 1, b = n
questions.explanation:
(C) 就是 Fisher-Yates Shuffle（洗牌演算法）：第 i 輪從 A[i..n] 中均勻挑一個放到位置 i，可能結果數 n · (n−1) ⋯ 1 = n!，每種排列恰好對應一組選擇，所以是均勻的。

  • (D) 不讓 A[i] 留在原地（Sattolo 演算法），只會產生循環排列。
  • (E) 每輪從全部 n 個挑，共 nn 種結果，nn 不是 n! 的倍數（n ≥ 3），不可能均勻。
  • (B) i = 1 時不交換，之後往前挑，同樣有 (n−1)! 種結果，數量不對；(A) 的機率分布更不均勻。

questions.question: (4 points) Which of the following statements is known to be true?
choices: (A) Every NP-hard problem is polynomial-time reducible to every problem in NP.
(B) Every NP-complete problem is polynomial-time reducible to every problem in NP.
(C) Every problem solvable in polynomial time is polynomial-time reducible to every problem in NP.
(D) Every problem solvable in exponential time is polynomial-time reducible to every problem in NP.
(E) None of the other choices.
questions.explanation:
關鍵：NP 裡有兩個「平凡」語言 ∅（全部答 No）和 Σ*（全部答 Yes）。任何非平凡問題都不可能歸約到它們，因為歸約必須把 Yes 實例送到 Yes、No 實例送到 No，而 ∅ 根本沒有 Yes 實例。

  • (A)(B) 錯：SAT 不能歸約到 ∅；而且就算排除平凡語言，這也等於說 NP-complete 歸約到 P 的問題，會推得 P = NP，未知。
  • (C) 錯：同樣卡在 ∅、Σ*。（排除這兩個之後才成立：P 的問題可以先自己解完、再輸出目標問題固定的 Yes/No 實例）
  • (D) 錯：EXP 有比 NP 更難的問題（時間階層定理），不可能全部歸約進 NP。

選 (E)。

questions.question:
(4 points) How many of the statements below are known to be true?

  • Every problem in NP is polynomial-time reducible to some NP-hard problem.
  • Every problem in NP is polynomial-time reducible to some NP-complete problem.
  • Every problem in NP is polynomial-time reducible to some problem solvable within polynomial time.
  • Every problem in NP is polynomial-time reducible to some problem solvable within exponential time.
questions.explanation:
1. 對：SAT 是 NP-hard，依定義所有 NP 問題都能歸約到它。
  2. 對：同上，SAT 也是 NP-complete。
  3. 未知：若成立，P 對多項式歸約封閉，會推得 NP ⊆ P，也就是 P = NP。
  4. 對：NP ⊆ EXP（枚舉所有證書），每個 NP 問題歸約到自己，而它本身就能在指數時間內解。

已知為真的有 3 個，選 (D)。

questions.question:
(4 points) A company needs to assign 3 workers to 3 tasks. Each worker can perform only the tasks listed below:

  • Worker W1: Tasks T1, T2
  • Worker W2: Task T1
  • Worker W3: Tasks T2, T3

Each worker can be assigned to at most one task, and each task to at most one worker. Which of the following statements is true?
choices: (A) The maximum matching has size 2.
(B) The maximum matching has size 1.
(C) No matching exists.
(D) There are exactly two distinct maximum matchings.
(E) There exists a perfect matching.
questions.explanation:
W2 只能做 T1，所以 W2–T1；W1 只剩 T2；W3 只剩 T3。得到 {W1–T2, W2–T1, W3–T3}，大小 3，是 Perfect Matching（完美匹配），選 (E)。

而且推導過程每一步都是被迫的，最大匹配唯一，(D) 錯；(A)(B)(C) 都低估了。

questions.question: (4 points) Which property of the root of unity Wn = e2πi/n, where n is a power of 2, allows the Cooley-Tukey fast-fourier transform algorithm to achieve its speedup in time complexity?
choices: (A) The Magnitude Property: |Wnk| = 1 for all k.
(B) The Symmetry Property: Wnk+n/2 = −Wnk, allowing dividing the problem into even/odd sub-problems.
(C) The Orthogonality Property: The sum of all roots Σk=0N−1 Wnk = 0.
(D) The Conjugate Property: Wnn−k = conj(Wnk).
(E) The Count Property: There are exactly n unique roots Wnk across all k.
questions.explanation:
FFT 把多項式拆成偶數項和奇數項：A(x) = Aeven(x²) + x · Aodd(x²)。因為 Wnk+n/2 = −Wnk（halving lemma 的來源），第 k 和第 k + n/2 個點只差一個正負號，共用同一組 Aeven、Aodd 的值，於是 n 個點只要算兩個 n/2 大小的子問題，T(n) = 2T(n/2) + Θ(n) = Θ(n log n)，選 (B)。

(C) 是逆轉換（inverse DFT）用到的性質，不是加速的來源。（選項 (D) 原卷以上橫線表示共軛）

questions.question: (4 points) Bucket sort has an expected linear runtime, O(n), under which of the following fundamental conditions?
choices: (A) The input values are uniformly distributed over the interval.
(B) The input array is already sorted.
(C) All elements are placed in a single bucket.
(D) The number of buckets is the same as the number of input elements.
(E) The number of buckets is smaller than the number of input elements.
questions.explanation:
Bucket sort 的期望線性時間建立在「輸入均勻分布」這個機率假設上：這樣每桶期望 O(1) 個元素，各桶用 insertion sort 的期望總成本才是 O(n)。題目問「fundamental condition」，選 (A)。

(D) 桶數 Θ(n) 也是分析中的設定，但光有 n 個桶而資料不均勻（例如全部落在同一桶，也就是 (C)）就會退化成 O(n²)，所以最根本的是分布假設。（待確認：若視為複選，(D) 也可能被接受）

questions.question: (4 points) Which algorithm guarantees finding the median (the n/2-th order statistic) of an array of n elements in O(n) worst-case time?
choices: (A) Sorting the array and then picking the median.
(B) Quickselect using random pivots.
(C) Using a max-heap or min-heap to extract the median.
(D) The median-of-medians selection algorithm.
(E) None of the other choices.
questions.explanation:
Median of Medians（中位數的中位數）：每 5 個一組取中位數，再遞迴找這些中位數的中位數當 pivot，保證至少約 3n/10 的元素在 pivot 兩側，T(n) ≤ T(n/5) + T(7n/10) + O(n)，因為 1/5 + 7/10 < 1，最差 O(n)，選 (D)。

(A) O(n log n)；(B) 期望 O(n)、最差 O(n²)；(C) 建 heap O(n) 但要 extract n/2 次，O(n log n)。

questions.question: (4 points) Which of the following properties is true for some optimal prefix-free binary code and directly justifies the greedy choice made in the Huffman algorithm?
choices: (A) The two symbols with the lowest frequencies must appear at the same depth in the code tree.
(B) The symbol with the lowest frequency must be assigned the longest codeword, but the symbol with the second smallest frequency need not be.
(C) All leaves at the maximum depth must correspond to symbols with the lowest frequency.
(D) The two symbols with the lowest frequencies must have equal codeword lengths, but they need not share the same parent.
(E) The two symbols with the lowest frequencies must be siblings at the maximum depth of the code tree.
questions.explanation:
Huffman 的 greedy-choice 引理：存在一棵最佳前綴碼樹，其中頻率最低的兩個符號 x、y 是同一個父親底下、位於最深層的兄弟。證明用交換論證：把最深的一對兄弟換成 x、y，總成本不會增加。這正是 Huffman「先合併最小的兩個」的依據，選 (E)。

(A)(D) 只講同深度、不講兄弟，不足以支撐「合併成一個節點」的動作；(B)(C) 敘述不正確或不夠。注意題目說「for some optimal code」：同頻率時最佳樹不唯一，只保證存在一棵滿足 (E)。

questions.question: (4 points) Consider a dynamic table that: (1) starts empty with capacity 1; (2) doubles its capacity when full; (3) shrinks its capacity by a factor of 1/2 when the capacity ≥ 4 and the number of stored elements falls below one quarter of the capacity. Assume that inserting or deleting an element costs 1, and resizing a table of size k costs Θ(k). Which statement is true when considering n insertion and removal operations?
choices: (A) The worst-case cost of any single operation is O(1), so amortized analysis is unnecessary.
(B) Using aggregate analysis, the amortized cost per operation is Θ(log n).
(C) If shrinking were performed when the table becomes half full instead of one quarter full, the amortized cost would still remain O(1).
(D) With the one-quarter shrinking rule, the amortized cost per operation is O(1), but shrinking more aggressively to half capacity when the table is half-full can destroy this bound.
(E) The amortized cost depends on the order of operations and cannot be bounded independently of the operation sequence.
questions.explanation:
「滿了翻倍、不到 1/4 才減半」：每次調整後 α 落在 1/2，距離下一次擴張或縮小都至少還要 Θ(容量) 次操作，可以用位能 Φ = 2·num − size（α ≥ 1/2）或 size/2 − num（α < 1/2）證出每次均攤 O(1)。

若改成「一半滿就減半」：在容量 k 滿時插入擴成 2k，刪一個就掉到一半以下又縮回 k，交替插入、刪除每次都花 Θ(k)，n 次操作總共 Θ(n²)。所以 (D) 對、(C) 錯。

(A) 單次擴張就 Θ(n)；(B) 均攤是 O(1)；(E) 均攤分析的意義就是對任何操作序列都有同一個上界。

questions.question: 12. [2%] Consider an algorithm with a running time function T(n) = 50n² + 200n log n + 106. Is it mathematically correct to claim that T(n) = O(n²)?
choices: (A) True
(B) False
questions.explanation: O 是上界：只要找到常數 c、n0 使 n ≥ n0 時 T(n) ≤ c·n²。n ≥ 1 時 200n log n ≤ 200n²、106 ≤ 106n²，取 c = 50 + 200 + 106 即可。最高次項是 50n²，其實 T(n) = Θ(n²)。常數 106 看起來很大，但它不隨 n 成長，在漸近分析中不重要。

questions.question: 13. [2%] Consider the famous "Halting Problem", which has been mathematically proven to be undecidable. Because the Halting Problem is strictly harder than any problem in NP, it satisfies the definition of being NP-Hard. Since the Halting Problem satisfies the NP-Hard property, it is therefore correctly classified as an NP-Complete (NPC) problem.
choices: (A) True
(B) False
questions.explanation: NP-Complete = NP-Hard 且屬於 NP。Halting problem 確實是 NP-hard（任何 NP 問題都能多項式歸約到它），但它是 undecidable，連驗證都做不到，不屬於 NP，所以不是 NP-complete。這題考的就是 NPC 定義的兩個條件缺一不可。

questions.question: 14. [2%] If a decision problem belongs to the class NP, it implies that given a specific candidate solution, there exists a deterministic algorithm that can verify whether this solution is correct in polynomial time.
choices: (A) True
(B) False
questions.explanation: 這正是 NP 的定義（verifier 版本）：對每個 yes 的實例存在一個多項式長度的 certificate，且有一個 deterministic 多項式時間演算法可以驗證它。等價於 nondeterministic 多項式時間可解。易錯：NP 不是「Non-Polynomial」，而是「Nondeterministic Polynomial」。

questions.question: 15. [2%] The 0/1 Knapsack Problem can be solved optimally by using a Greedy strategy that always selects the item with the highest value-to-weight ratio first.
choices: (A) True
(B) False
questions.explanation: 依 value/weight 的 greedy 只對 fractional knapsack（可以切）是最佳的。0/1 版本反例：容量 50，物品 (w=10, v=60)、(20, 100)、(30, 120)，比值 6、5、4。greedy 先拿前兩個得 160，剩 20 放不下第三個；但拿後兩個可得 220。0/1 knapsack 要用 DP，Θ(nW)。

questions.question: 16. [2%] Suppose a problem called "Robot-Path-Planning" is a known NP-Complete problem. To prove that a related new problem "3-SAT" is also NP-Complete, we must demonstrate that "3-SAT" is in NP, and we must construct a polynomial-time reduction from "3-SAT" to "Robot-Path-Planning"
choices: (A) True
(B) False
questions.explanation: 要證明新問題 X 是 NP-complete：(1) X ∈ NP；(2) 從已知的 NPC 問題歸約到 X，也就是 Robot-Path-Planning ≤p 3-SAT。題目把方向寫反了：3-SAT ≤p Robot-Path-Planning 只能說明 3-SAT 不比它難，證不出 3-SAT 是 NP-hard。口訣：「拿已知很難的問題，變成新問題」。

questions.question:
1. [10%] Assuming that you are a medical information analyst, currently analyzing an algorithm designed to process a 3D MRI volume. The input is a cubic volume of data with side length n (total voxels = n × n × n). Assume n is a power of 2.

Pseudo-code:

Surface_Scan(n)
    total_intensity = 0
    for i = 1 to n
        for j = 1 to 100
            total_intensity = total_intensity + Read_Pixel(i, j)
    return total_intensity

MRI_Voxel_Process(n)
    if n <= 1
        return

    for k = 1 to n
        Surface_Scan(n)

    for x = 0 to 1
        for y = 0 to 1
            for z = 0 to 1
                MRI_Voxel_Process(n/2)

Note: Assume that the function Read_Pixel(i, j) takes constant time

Questions:

(1) [3%] Analyze the Surface_Scan(n) function and determine its time complexity using Θ-notation.

(2) [3%] Write down the recurrence relation for the running time T(n) of MRI_Voxel_Process(n).

(3) [4%] Analyze the asymptotic growth rate of the algorithm, and determine the overall asymptotic tight bound (Θ) for the running time of MRI_Voxel_Process(n). Please write down your calculation process.
questions.explanation:
(1) 外層 n 次、內層固定 100 次，共 100n 次常數時間操作 → Θ(n)。內層的 100 是常數，不會變成 n²。

(2) 呼叫 n 次 Surface_Scan，每次 Θ(n)，共 Θ(n²)；x、y、z 各 2 種，遞迴呼叫 2³ = 8 次，大小 n/2：

T(n) = 8T(n/2) + Θ(n²),  T(1) = Θ(1)

(3) Master theorem：a = 8、b = 2，nlog28 = n³；f(n) = n² = O(n3−ε)（ε = 1）→ case 1，T(n) = Θ(n³)。

直覺：遞迴樹第 i 層有 8i 個子問題，每個 (n/2i)²，該層總成本 n²·2i，越往下越大，由最底層的 n³ 個葉子主導。剛好等於 voxel 總數 n³，也就是每個 voxel 平均只花常數時間。

questions.question:
2. [10%] You are a process engineer managing a critical Lithography Machine. The machine has a strict Thermal Constraint:

Constraint: You cannot schedule production for two consecutive shifts. If Shift i is active, Shift i − 1 and Shift i + 1 must be idle (cooling).

Data: The estimated Production Yield Value for the upcoming 13 shifts is listed below.

Shift IDS1S2S3S4S5S6S7S8S9S10S11S12S13
Value45954535854540856565403590

Questions:

(1) [4%] Identify the set of shifts that results in the maximum possible total value while satisfying the thermal constraint. (Selected Shifts, e.g., S1, S2, ...; Total Value)

(2) [4%] A very important client demands that Shift 7 (Value: 40) MUST be included in the schedule. Under this mandatory condition, what is the maximum total value you can achieve for the 13 shifts? (Selected Shifts with S7; Total Value with S7)

(3) [2%] Process Upgrade: The High-Temperature Machine Imagine the factory installs a new, high-performance machine. This machine generates significantly more heat, so the safety constraint is updated:

New Constraint: After any active shift, the machine must cool down for TWO consecutive shifts

Let f[i] be the maximum value achievable considering shifts up to i, and let vi be the value of Shift i. Please write down the complete Recurrence Relation (Mathematical Equation) for f[i].
questions.explanation:
這是「不能選相鄰」的經典 DP（house robber）：f[i] = max(f[i−1], vi + f[i−2])，f[0] = 0、f[−1] = 0。

i12345678910111213
vi45954535854540856565403590
f[i]459595130180180220265285330330365420

(1) 最大值 420。回溯：f[13] 取 v13 + f[11] → f[11] = f[10] → 取 v10 + f[8] → 取 v8 + f[6] → f[6] = f[5] → 取 v5 + f[3] → f[3] = f[2] → 取 v2。所選為 S2, S5, S8, S10, S13：95 + 85 + 85 + 65 + 90 = 420。

(2) 強制選 S7，則 S6、S8 不能選，問題拆成左段 S1～S5 和右段 S9～S13 各自求最大：

  • 左段最大 f[5] = 180（S2 + S5）。
  • 右段 65, 65, 40, 35, 90：最大 195（S9 + S11 + S13）。

總值 180 + 40 + 195 = 415，選 S2, S5, S7, S9, S11, S13。比 (1) 少 5，這就是客戶指定 S7 的「代價」。

(3) 選了 i 之後 i+1、i+2 都要冷卻，等價於選 i 時前一個能選的最晚是 i−3：

f[i] = max( f[i−1], v_i + f[i−3] ),   f[i] = 0 for i ≤ 0

（以上三小題都用程式窮舉所有 213 種選法驗證，最佳解唯一。）

questions.question:
3. [10%] You are analyzing the routing latencies for a constellation of 4 satellites (Nodes A, B, C, D). Below is the adjacency list with the latency between specific nodes:

Adjacency List:

A → B: 10
A → C: -5
C → B: 4
B → D: 5
D → C: 2
D → A: 3

Requirement: You need to analyze the latency characteristics of the network so that shortest communication paths can be efficiently determined when needed

Questions:

(1) [4%] Based on the specific properties of the edges in this graph and the problem requirement, identify the single most appropriate standard algorithm to use. Explain your choice by pointing out the specific graph feature that disqualifies other algorithms, and explicitly state why at least one other commonly used shortest-path algorithm would fail or be inappropriate in this case.

(2) [2%] Let M be the initial 4 × 4 distance matrix used at the start of your chosen algorithm. Please construct and write down M clearly. (Note: Use "∞" for non-existing edges and "0" for self-loops. Order: A, B, C, D)

(3) [4%] After the algorithm completes execution

(a) [2%] What is the final shortest path cost from Node D to Node B? Please trace the path logic (e.g., D → ... → B).

(b) [2%] State the asymptotic Time Complexity Θ of this algorithm.
questions.answer: (1) Floyd-Warshall；(2) M 見詳解；(3)(a) 2，D → A → C → B；(b) Θ(V³)
questions.explanation:
(1) Floyd-Warshall。理由：

  • 需求是「需要時能快速查到任兩點的最短路徑」→ 全點對最短路徑（all-pairs）。
  • 圖中有負權重邊 A → C = −5 → Dijkstra 不能用：它假設一個點一旦被取出，距離就確定了；有負邊時，之後可能經由負邊找到更短的路，結果會錯。
  • 先確認沒有負環：A→C→B→D→A = −5+4+5+3 = 7，D→C→B→D = 11，都是正的，所以最短路徑有定義。
  • Bellman-Ford 雖然能處理負邊，但只算單一起點，要對每個點跑一次 Θ(V²E)；圖這麼小又是全點對需求，Floyd-Warshall 的 Θ(V³) 最直接（大而稀疏的圖才會考慮 Johnson）。

(2) 初始矩陣（列 = 起點，行 = 終點）：

        A    B    C    D
A  [    0   10   -5    ∞ ]
B  [    ∞    0    ∞    5 ]
C  [    ∞    4    0    ∞ ]
D  [    3    ∞    2    0 ]

(3)(a) D 到 B 的候選：D → C → B = 2 + 4 = 6；D → A → C → B = 3 − 5 + 4 = 2；D → A → B = 13。最短為 2，路徑 D → A → C → B。關鍵是繞到 A 再走負邊 A → C，雖然多走一步卻更便宜。（已用 Floyd-Warshall 程式驗算，最終矩陣 D 列為 [3, 2, −2, 0]。）

(b) 三層迴圈各 |V| 次 → Θ(V³)。

questions.question:
4. [10%] You are optimizing the core engine of an image editing tool called "Smart Lasso". The tool helps users extract objects by automatically finding the best boundary between a Start Pixel (S) and a Target Pixel (T).

The image is represented as a grid of pixels. Each pixel has an associated "Energy Cost" (representing high-frequency noise or weak edges). Here are some rules:

  • Movement Rule: From any pixel, you can move to adjacent pixels (Up, Down, Left, Right). Diagonal movement is not allowed.
  • Path Cost: The sum of the Energy Costs of all pixels visited on the path (excluding S, but including T).

Energy cost matrix is shown as below (assume the cost of entering T is 0):

S  4  5  9  8
7  9  8  6  9
3  2  4  1  5
6  5  6  7  T

In the following, we will use (row, col) as coordinate representation. Top-left is (0, 0).

If two neighbors have the same cost, prioritize the direction in this order: Right → Down → Up → Left

Questions:

(1) [4%] A junior developer implemented a "High-Speed Mode" for the lasso. The logic is simple: "At every step, the cursor simply snaps to the immediate neighbor with the lowest energy cost to get closer to the target. It does not plan ahead." Please trace the path generated by this method from S to T and calculate the total cost. (Path Sequence, e.g., (0,0) → (0,1) → ...; Total Path Cost)

(2) [4%] Users have complained that the "High-Speed Mode" (from Q 4.1) often gets "trapped" in noisy areas or takes expensive detours, failing to find the true object boundary. Your manager asks you to rewrite the core engine. The new requirement is: "The tool must guarantee finding the mathematically optimal boundary—the path with the absolute minimum Total Cumulative Cost from Start to Target—even if it takes a bit more computation time." Please trace the path generated by this method from S to T and calculate the total cost.

(3) [2%] The solution in Q 4.2 works great on small grids. However, when applied to a 4K Image (with N pixels), the tool becomes laggy. Profiling reveals the bottleneck is in the Open Set (Priority Queue)—specifically, the operation of repeatedly finding and removing the pixel with the minimum cumulative cost. You are comparing two underlying data structures for this Priority Queue: a simple Unsorted Array vs. a Binary Min-Heap. Please analyze the Time Complexity (Big-O) for the "Extract-Min" operation in both cases: Case 1: Unsorted Array; Case 2: Binary Min-Heap.
questions.explanation:
(1) Greedy：每一步只看相鄰、尚未走過的格子，挑成本最小的（同分依 右 → 下 → 上 → 左）：

  1. (0,0)：右 4、下 7 → (0,1)
  2. (0,1)：右 5、下 9 → (0,2)
  3. (0,2)：右 9、下 8 → (1,2)
  4. (1,2)：右 6、下 4、左 9 → (2,2)
  5. (2,2)：右 1、下 6、左 2 → (2,3)
  6. (2,3)：右 5、下 7、上 6 → (2,4)
  7. (2,4)：下 T = 0 → (3,4)

成本 4 + 5 + 8 + 4 + 1 + 5 + 0 = 27。（「走過的格子不再走」這個前提題目沒明說，但這條路線剛好沒有需要回頭的地方。）

(2) Dijkstra（成本都非負，適用）：把每格的「進入成本」當作邊權，從 S 求到 T 的最短距離，得到最小成本 22：

(0,0) → (1,0) → (2,0) → (2,1) → (2,2) → (2,3) → (2,4) → (3,4)，成本 7 + 3 + 2 + 4 + 1 + 5 + 0 = 22。

greedy 第一步貪 4 而往右走，結果被上面兩列的高成本困住；最佳路徑第一步先付 7，換來底下第 2 列一整排便宜的格子。比 greedy 省 5，約 19%。（已用程式驗算。）

(3)

  • Unsorted array：每次 extract-min 都要掃過全部候選才知道誰最小，O(N)；Dijkstra 總共 O(N²)。
  • Binary min-heap：取根後把最後一個元素放上去再往下調整，O(log N)；Dijkstra 總共 O((N + E) log N)，格點圖 E ≈ 4N，所以約 O(N log N)。

4K 影像約 830 萬像素，N² 和 N log N 差了數十萬倍，這就是換成 heap 的理由。

questions.question:
（第 5 題）Consider the max-flow problem. Let G = (V, E) be a network with edge capacity ce for all e ∈ E and source-sink pair s, t ∈ V.
⑬ Which of the following statements is/are true?
choices: (A) If (S, V − S) and (S′, V − S′) are both valid s-t cuts, then so is (S ∪ S′, V − (S ∪ S′)).
(B) If f<sub>1</sub>, f<sub>2</sub> are both feasible s-t flow functions, then so is f<sub>1</sub> + f<sub>2</sub>, which adds up the flows of each pair of nodes.
(C) For any feasible s-t flow function f with value Val(f) and any feasible s-t cut C with total capacity c(C), we always have Val(f) ≥ c(C).
(D) Applying the Bellman-Ford algorithm returns the maximum flow for G.
(E) The Ford-Fulkerson algorithm can be modified to solve the maximum flow problem in polynomial-time.
questions.explanation:
• (A) 對：s ∈ S 且 s ∈ S′，所以 s ∈ S ∪ S′；t 不在 S 也不在 S′，所以 t 不在聯集裡，仍是合法 s-t cut。
  • (B) 錯：相加可能超過容量。例如只有一條邊 s→t 容量 1，f1 = f2 = 1，相加變 2 > 1。
  • (C) 錯：方向反了。任何 flow 的值 ≤ 任何 cut 的容量（weak duality），等號只在 max flow = min cut 時成立。
  • (D) 錯：Bellman-Ford 是最短路徑演算法，不是最大流。
  • (E) 對：一般 Ford-Fulkerson 在容量很大時可能跑很多輪；改成每次用 BFS 找最短增廣路徑（Edmonds-Karp）就是 O(VE²)，多項式時間。

questions.question:
（第 5 題）Consider the following residual flow network.
（原圖以有向邊列表描述，標示為 flow/capacity）
S → A: 7/12    S → D: 7/11    D → A: 2/5
A → C: 9/10    C → D: 2/5     D → B: 7/8
C → B: 11/12   B → C: 6/7     C → T: 2/3
B → T: 12/20
⑭ Which of the following statements is/are true?
choices: (A) The path S → A → C → B → T is a valid augmenting path with value 1.
(B) Let P = {S, A, D} and Q = {B, C, T}. Then (P, Q) is a minimum S-T cut with weight 23.
(C) The Edmonds-Karp algorithm will use S → A → C → B → T as an augmenting path.
(D) Changing the residual weight settings of the three edges (D, A), (A, C), and (C, D) to 0/5, 7/10, and 0/5 will increase the value of the maximum flow by 2.
(E) If we add a new edge (D, C) with capacity 2 to the network, the value of the minimum S-T cut will also increase by 2.
questions.explanation:
目前流量 = 7 + 7 = 14。

  • (A) 對：剩餘容量 S→A 5、A→C 1、C→B 1、B→T 8，瓶頸 1，是合法的增廣路徑。
  • (B) 錯：({S, A, D}, {B, C, T}) 是最小割沒錯，但容量 = A→C 10 + D→B 8 = 18，不是 23（C→D 從 Q 指回 P，不算）。程式窮舉所有 cut，最小值也是 18。
  • (C) 錯：Edmonds-Karp 每次走邊數最少的增廣路徑。目前有 3 條邊的 S→A→C→T，會先用它；用完後 A→C 就飽和了，S→A→C→B→T 之後也走不通。
  • (D) 錯：改成 0/5、7/10、0/5 只是換一種流法（檢查守恆：A 進 7 出 7、D 進 7 出 7、C 進 13 出 13），流量還是 14；最大流由容量決定，仍是 18，不會增加。
  • (E) 對：新增 D→C 容量 2，D 在 P 側、C 在 Q 側，原本的最小割容量變 20；程式重算所有 cut 的最小值也是 20，增加 2。

questions.question:
(13%) Consider a directed graph G, consisting of four vertices labeled A, B, C, and D. The graph has the following edges with their respective weights: edge from A to B with weight 2, edge from B to D with weight 1, edge from A to C with weight -4, and edge from C to B with weight 3.
Given the Pseudo Code for Bellman-Ford Algorithm:
Input: Graph G with vertices V and edges E, source vertex s
Output: Shortest path from s to other vertices, or detection of a negative cycle
1. function BellmanFord(G, s):
2.     // Initialization
3.     for each vertex v in V do
4.         dist[v] := ___(1)___
5.         prev[v] := undefined
6.     dist[s] := ___(2)___
7.
8.     // Main Loop
9.     for i from 1 to |V|-1:
10.        for each edge (u, v) in E:
11.            if dist[u] + weight(u, v) ___(3)___ dist[v]:
12.                dist[v] := dist[u] + weight(u, v)
13.                prev[v] := u
14.
15.    // Check for negative weight cycles
16.    for each edge (u, v) in E:
17.        if dist[u] + weight(u, v) ___(4)___ dist[v]:
18.            return "Graph contains a negative weight cycle"
19.
20.    return dist, prev
(A) [4%] What values should be filled in to (1), (2), (3), (4) in the Pseudo Code?
(B) [3%] Let the source vertex be 'A'. After the first iteration of the main loop, what is the updated value of `dist[C]`?
(C) [3%] Let the source vertex be 'A'. In the second iteration of the main loop, after processing the edge from C to B, what will be the new value of `dist[B]`?
(D) [3%] Let the source vertex be 'A'. What will be the final value of `dist[D]` after the algorithm completes its execution?
questions.explanation:
(A) 一開始除了起點都不知道怎麼到，設 ∞；起點到自己距離 0；鬆弛（relax）條件是「經過 u 比較近」才更新，所以 (3) 是 <；跑完 |V| − 1 輪後如果還能變小，代表有負環，(4) 也是 <。

(B) 依題目列出邊的順序 A→B、B→D、A→C、C→B 處理第 1 輪：dist[B] = 2、dist[D] = 3、dist[C] = −4、再由 C→B 得 dist[B] = −4 + 3 = −1。第 1 輪結束時 dist[C] = −4。不論邊的處理順序，A→C 這條邊在第 1 輪一定會被處理到，所以答案都是 −4。

(C) 第 2 輪處理 C→B 時：−4 + 3 = −1，不小於目前的 −1，不更新，dist[B] = −1（若第 1 輪的順序沒讓 B 更新到 −1，第 2 輪處理 C→B 時也會變成 −1，結果相同）。

(D) 最短路徑 A→C→B→D = −4 + 3 + 1 = 0（比 A→B→D = 3 短）。圖中沒有環，所以沒有負環。程式模擬 3 輪：第 1 輪後 D = 3，第 2 輪由 B = −1 更新成 0，第 3 輪不再變。

questions.question:
(14%) Recurrence formula is what it takes to solve a problem with the dynamic programming technique. In this problem we examine the recurrence formulas for two different sequence problems.
  • Consider the longest increasing subsequence (LIS) problem. Let A = a1, a2, …, an be the input sequence of n numbers. For any 0 ≤ i ≤ n, let T(i) denote the maximum length of any increasing subsequence of A that ends at position i.
It is well-known that T(i) can be expressed as the following recurrence formula.
T(i) = 0,                                    if i = 0,
       max { T(j) + 1 : 0 ≤ j < i, aj < ai },   if 1 ≤ i ≤ n,
where in the formula we define a0 := −∞ for convenience. The answer to the input sequence is then given by max1≤i≤n T(i).
  • Next, consider the "Longest Palindrome Bimodal Subsequence Problem", which is defined as follows. Let A = a1, a2, …, an be a sequence of n numbers.
    A subsequence B = b1, b2, …, bm of A is called a bimodal subsequence with pivot k, 1 ≤ k ≤ m, if B is an increasing sequence before position k and a decreasing sequence after position k. That is, bi < bi+1 holds for all 1 ≤ i < k and bj > bj+1 holds for all k ≤ j < m.
    Furthermore, we say that a bimodal sequence B = b1, b2, …, bm with pivot k is a palindrome bimodal sequence if k = (m + 1)/2.
For any 1 ≤ i ≤ n, let PV(i) denote the maximum length of any palindrome bimodal subsequence of A that pivots at position i. Write down a valid recurrence formula for PV(i), as the format given above for T(i) for the LIS problem.
You may define other auxiliary functions necessary to compose the recurrence formula for PV(i). However, make sure you provide a precise and succinct definition.
questions.answer: 定義 D(i) = 從位置 i 開始的最長嚴格遞減子序列長度：D(n+1) = 0、a<sub>n+1</sub> := −∞，D(i) = max{ D(j) + 1 : i < j ≤ n+1, a<sub>j</sub> < a<sub>i</sub> }；則 PV(i) = 2·min(T(i), D(i)) − 1。
questions.explanation:
觀察：以 ai 為 pivot 的 palindrome bimodal 子序列，長度 m = 2k − 1：前面是長度 k、以 ai 結尾的遞增子序列，後面是長度 k、從 ai 開始的遞減子序列，兩段共用 ai。所以關鍵是「左邊最多能遞增多長」與「右邊最多能遞減多長」，取兩者較小的那個當 k。

輔助函數：D(i) = 以位置 i 開頭的最長嚴格遞減子序列長度。它就是把 LIS 從右邊做回來：

D(i) = 0,                                         若 i = n + 1（定義 a_{n+1} := −∞）
D(i) = max{ D(j) + 1 : i < j ≤ n + 1, a_j < a_i },   若 1 ≤ i ≤ n

答案：

PV(i) = 2 · min( T(i), D(i) ) − 1,   1 ≤ i ≤ n

為什麼可以取 min：若 T(i) = t，表示存在長度 t 的遞增子序列以 ai 結尾；取它的最後 k 項（k ≤ t）仍是遞增且以 ai 結尾。遞減那段同理取前 k 項。所以兩邊都能湊出長度 k = min(T(i), D(i))，而且不能更長。

例子：A = 1, 3, 2, 5, 4, 0。在 a4 = 5：T = 3（1, 3, 5 或 1, 2, 5）、D = 3（5, 4, 0），PV = 5，子序列 1, 3, 5, 4, 0。

這個公式用程式在 300 組隨機小數列上與窮舉所有子序列的結果比對，全部一致。時間 O(n²)：T、D 各 O(n²)，PV 每個 O(1)。

questions.question: （複選）Which of the followings are true?
choices: (A) f(n) = Θ(g(n)) if and only if f(n) = O(g(n)) and f(n) = Ω(g(n)).
(B) f(n) = o(g(n)) if and only if f(n) = O(g(n)) and f(n) ≠ Ω(g(n)).
(C) T(n) = 2·T(√n) + Θ(log n) has a solution T(n) = O((log n)<sup>2</sup>).
(D) T(n) = 8·T(n/3 + 12) + n<sup>2</sup> has a solution T(n) = Θ(n<sup>2</sup>).
(E) T(n) = 2·T(n/4) + √n has a solution T(n) = Ω(√n).
questions.explanation:
• (A) 對：Θ 的定義就是同時有上界與下界。
  • (B) 錯：o(g) 要求 f/g → 0。反例：f(n) 在 n 為偶數時 = n、奇數時 = 1，g(n) = n：f = O(n)，而且 f ≠ Ω(n)（奇數項太小），但 f/g 不趨近 0（偶數項比值是 1），所以 f ≠ o(n)。
  • (C) 對：令 m = log n、S(m) = T(2m)，得 S(m) = 2S(m/2) + Θ(m) = Θ(m log m)，所以 T(n) = Θ(log n · log log n) = O((log n)²)。
  • (D) 對：+12 不影響漸近結果，看成 8T(n/3) + n²。nlog38 ≈ n1.89 < n²，且 8(n/3)² = (8/9)n² 滿足 regularity，Master Theorem 第三種情況 Θ(n²)。
  • (E) 對：a = 2、b = 4，nlog42 = √n，第二種情況 Θ(√n log n)，當然是 Ω(√n)。

questions.question:
（複選）An m × n array A of real numbers is a Monge array if for any rows 1 ≤ i < k ≤ m and any columns 1 ≤ j < ℓ ≤ n, we always have
A[i, j] + A[k, ℓ] ≤ A[i, ℓ] + A[k, j].        (1)
In other words, for the four entries at rows i, k and columns j, ℓ, the sum of the upper-left and lower-right elements is always at most the sum of the lower-left and upper-right elements. Consider the following two arrays
      ┌ 10 17 13 28 23 ┐
      │ 17 22 16 29 23 │          ┌ 37 23 22 32 ┐
      │ 24 28 22 34 24 │          │ 21  6  7 10 │
M1 =  │ 11 13  6 17  7 │   M2 =   │ 53 34 30 31 │
      │ 45 44 32 37 23 │          │ 32 13  9  6 │
      │ 36 33 19 21  6 │          └ 43 21 15  8 ┘
      └ 75 66 51 53 34 ┘
It can be verified that M1 is a Monge array and M2 is not. Which of the followings are true?
choices: (A) To verify that the array A is a Monge array, it suffices to verify the inequality (1) for every rows i, i + 2 and every columns j, ℓ, where 1 ≤ i ≤ m − 2 and 1 ≤ j < ℓ ≤ n.
(B) Changing the value of the element 7 in M<sub>2</sub> to 13 makes it a Monge array.
(C) To make M<sub>2</sub> a Monge array, at least two elements must change their values.
(D) Suppose that A is a Monge array and let f(i) denote the column index of the leftmost smallest element at row i. Then f(k) ≥ f(i) for any 1 ≤ i < k ≤ m.

(E) A is a Monge array if and only if for any 1 ≤ i < m and 1 ≤ j < l ≤ n, we always have
A[i, j] + A[i + 1, ℓ] ≤ A[i, ℓ] + A[i + 1, j].
questions.explanation:
程式檢查：M2 違反 (1) 的地方只有第 1、2 列與第 (1, 3)、(2, 3) 欄：例如 37 + 7 = 44 > 22 + 21 = 43，以及 23 + 7 = 30 > 22 + 6 = 28。

  • (A) 錯：只檢查隔一列的 (i, i+2) 不夠，相鄰列 (i, i+1) 的關係完全沒檢查到。M2 的違規剛好就在相鄰的第 1、2 列。
  • (B) 錯：7 改成 13 讓第 1、2 列的違規更嚴重（37 + 13 > 22 + 21），也會造成第 2、3 列新的違規。
  • (C) 錯：只改一個元素就夠，例如把 7 改成 2（37 + 2 ≤ 43、23 + 2 ≤ 28 都成立），或把第 1 列的 22 改成 24。程式窮舉驗證這兩種單點修改都讓 M2 變成 Monge。
  • (D) 對：Monge array 的經典性質：每列最左邊最小值的位置隨列數單調不遞減。若 i < k 卻 f(k) < f(i)，取 j = f(k)、ℓ = f(i)，由 (1) A[i, j] + A[k, ℓ] ≤ A[i, ℓ] + A[k, j]，再配合兩列最小值的定義可推出矛盾。M1 的 f 值是 1, 3, 3, 3, 5, 5, 5，確實不遞減。
  • (E) 對：只檢查相鄰列（但任意兩欄）就足夠，因為把 (i, k) 拆成 (i, i+1)、(i+1, i+2)、… 的相鄰不等式相加，中間項會抵消，得到原本的不等式。（甚至只檢查相鄰列、相鄰欄就夠。）

choices: (A) The call of findPermutation("000") returns the vector {3, 2, 1, 0}
(B) Permutation (3, 1, 2, 0, 4) can be represented as "0101", but it is not the corresponding output of the call of findPermutation("0101").
(C) findPermutation takes O(n log n) time to recover the permutation, where n is the length of the permutation.
(D) Not all the input can have an answer returned from the procedure findPermutation.
(E) The call of findPermutation("01001") returns the vector {3, 2, 4, 1, 0, 5}.
questions.explanation:
想法：起點設成「0 的個數」，遇到 '1' 就用目前最大值 + 1，遇到 '0' 就用目前最小值 − 1。因為 '0' 共有 left 個，往下最多走到 0；'1' 共有 n − 1 − left 個，往上最多走到 n − 1，剛好用完 0..n−1 每個數一次。

  • (A) 對：left = 3，輸出 3, 2, 1, 0。
  • (B) 對：(3, 1, 2, 0, 4)：3 > 1、1 < 2、2 > 0、0 < 4，字串是 "0101"；但 findPermutation("0101") 輸出 {2, 1, 3, 0, 4}（程式驗證），不是它。
  • (C)：實際是 O(n)（count 一次、迴圈一次）。O 是上界，O(n) 的演算法也屬於 O(n log n)，所以字面上成立；若出題者的意思是「需要 n log n 那麼久」就不對（待確認）。
  • (D) 錯：任何 0-1 字串都會得到合法排列，理由如上。
  • (E) 對：left = 3：起點 3，0 → 2，1 → 4，0 → 1，0 → 0，1 → 5，得 {3, 2, 4, 1, 0, 5}（程式驗證）。

questions.question: （複選）Let p be a prime number. Consider a positive integer a. We want to find another positive integer b such that 1 = ab mod p. Let p = 101, a = 55. Which of the following statements about b is/are true?
choices: (A) There are infinitely many b's such that 1 = ab mod p.
(B) (b mod p) has 2 digits.
(C) a < b.
(D) ((b mod p) mod 10) > 3.
(E) The digit sum of (b mod p) > 10.

questions.question: （複選）Let A and B be two arrays and each has n positive numbers. Given a permutation π of {1, 2, ..., n}, we can compute the sum Σ<sub>i=1</sub><sup>n</sup> A[i] * B[π(i)]. We are interested in finding the maximum of the sum, which can be maximized with a proper permutation π. Which of the following statements is/are true?
choices: (A) If a ≤ b and c ≤ d, then a * c + b * d ≥ a * d + b * c.
(B) If A=[1, 3, 2, 4], B=[3, 4, 2, 1], then the maximum sum is 30.
(C) This problem can be solved in o(n) time.
(D) This problem can be solved with the Greedy method.
(E) When the maximum is achieved, the corresponding permutation π will always make array B sorted.
questions.explanation:
這是 Rearrangement Inequality（排序不等式）：大配大、小配小，乘積和最大。

  • (A) 對：(ac + bd) − (ad + bc) = (b − a)(d − c) ≥ 0。這也是 greedy 的交換論證：若有「大配小」的交叉，交換後不會變差。
  • (B) 對：A 由小到大 1, 2, 3, 4 配 B 由小到大 1, 2, 3, 4：1 + 4 + 9 + 16 = 30。程式窮舉 24 種排列，最大值也是 30。
  • (C) 錯：o(n) 連把 n 個數讀完都不夠，更何況要排序（O(n log n)）。
  • (D) 對：兩邊排序後依序配對，就是 greedy。
  • (E) 錯：最佳的 π 讓 B[π(i)] 的大小順序和 A 一致，不是讓 B 本身變成排序好的。例如 (B) 中 A = [1, 3, 2, 4]，最佳配對是 B[π(i)] = [1, 3, 2, 4]，並沒有排序。

questions.question:
(10%). You are given a directed acyclic graph G = (V, E) with real-valued edge weights and two distinguished vertices s, t ∈ V. The weight of a path is the sum of the weights of the edges in the path.
(a) Describe a dynamic-programming approach for finding a simple path from s to t with the maximum weight. Write down the recurrence formula you use and the definition of the subproblem(s) explicitly.
(b) What is the running time of your algorithm?
questions.answer: (a) L(v) = s 到 v 的最大路徑權重；L(s) = 0，L(v) = max<sub>(u,v)∈E</sub> { L(u) + w(u, v) }（沒有前驅可達時 −∞），依拓樸順序計算，答案 L(t)，用 pred 還原路徑；(b) O(V + E)。
questions.explanation:
子問題：L(v) = 從 s 走到 v 的所有路徑中最大的權重；走不到就是 −∞。

L(s) = 0
L(v) = max{ L(u) + w(u, v) : (u, v) ∈ E }   （v ≠ s；沒有任何 u 時為 −∞）

計算順序：先做 Topological Sort（拓樸排序），依拓樸順序計算 L(v)。因為所有進入 v 的邊都來自拓樸順序在前面的點，算 L(v) 時需要的 L(u) 都已經算好了。同時記 pred[v] = 使最大值成立的 u，最後從 t 沿著 pred 往回走就是路徑。

為什麼是 simple path：DAG 沒有 cycle，任何路徑都不會重複經過頂點，自動是 simple path。這也是一般圖上最長簡單路徑是 NP-hard、DAG 上卻能多項式解的原因。邊權可以是負的也沒關係。

(b) 拓樸排序 O(V + E)；每條邊在 max 裡只被看一次，DP 也是 O(V + E)。總共 O(V + E)。

questions.question: (6%). A palindrome is a non-empty string over some alphabet that reads the same forward and backward. Examples of palindromes are all strings of length 1, civic, racecar, and aibohphobia. Give an efficient (polynomial-time) algorithm to find the longest palindrome that is a subsequence of a given input string. For example, given the input character, your algorithm should return carac. What is the time complexity of your algorithm?
questions.answer: 區間 DP：L[i][j] = s[i..j] 的最長回文子序列長度；s[i] = s[j] 時 L[i][j] = L[i+1][j−1] + 2，否則 max(L[i+1][j], L[i][j−1])；依區間長度由短到長填表，再回溯得到字串。O(n²) 時間與空間。
questions.explanation:
定義：L[i][j] = 子字串 s[i..j] 中最長回文子序列的長度。

L[i][i]   = 1
L[i][j]   = 0                               若 i > j
L[i][j]   = L[i+1][j−1] + 2                 若 s[i] = s[j]
L[i][j]   = max( L[i+1][j], L[i][j−1] )     若 s[i] ≠ s[j]

理由：兩端相同時，把它們分別當作回文的頭尾一定不吃虧；兩端不同時，最長回文至少捨棄其中一端，看捨棄哪一端比較好。

順序：依區間長度 1, 2, …, n 填表；答案長度在 L[1][n]。還原：從 (1, n) 開始，若 s[i] = s[j] 就把兩個字元放到結果的頭尾並走到 (i+1, j−1)，否則走向值較大的那一格。

以 character 為例，程式跑出長度 5 的 carac（c-a-r-a-c）。

時間：n² / 2 個格子，每格 O(1)，共 O(n²)；空間 O(n²)。另一種做法：最長回文子序列 = s 與 reverse(s) 的 LCS，也是 O(n²)（但直接取 LCS 的字串不一定就是回文，需要小心處理，區間 DP 比較直接）。

questions.question:
(10%)
(a) (4%) Given a graph G(V, E), show how to find the maximum number of edge disjoint paths from the source s to the sink t. This means that you should construct a set of paths such that each edge appears in at most one path. Consider the following example with s = 1, t = 6. What is the maximum number of edge-disjoint paths?
（原圖以有向邊列表描述）
1 → 2   1 → 4   2 → 4   3 → 2   4 → 3
4 → 5   3 → 5   3 → 6   5 → 6
(b) (6%) Show how to find the maximum number of node-disjoint paths from the source to the sink. This means that you should construct a set of paths such that every node, except for the source and sink, may appear in at most 1 path.
questions.answer: (a) 每條邊容量設 1，求 s 到 t 的最大流，最大流值 = 邊不相交路徑的最大數目；本例為 2（例如 1→2→4→3→6 與 1→4→5→6）。(b) 把每個 s、t 以外的點 v 拆成 v<sub>in</sub> → v<sub>out</sub>（容量 1），原邊 (u, v) 改成 u<sub>out</sub> → v<sub>in</sub>，再求最大流（本例為 1）。
questions.explanation:
(a) 每條邊容量設成 1，跑最大流（例如 Ford-Fulkerson / Edmonds-Karp）。整數容量下存在整數最大流，每條邊流量是 0 或 1；把流量 1 的邊從 s 開始拆成路徑，就得到邊不相交的路徑，條數 = 流量。反過來，任何 k 條邊不相交路徑都能變成值為 k 的流。所以兩者相等。（等價於 Menger 定理：最大邊不相交路徑數 = 最小邊割的大小。）

本例：從 1 出去只有 1→2、1→4 兩條邊，答案 ≤ 2。實際找得到 2 條：1→2→4→3→6 與 1→4→5→6，兩條路沒有共用邊。程式跑單位容量最大流得 2。

(b) 限制點而不是邊時，用拆點：每個 v ∉ {s, t} 拆成 vin、vout，加一條 vin → vout 容量 1 的邊；原本的邊 (u, v) 改接 uout → vin（容量 1 或 ∞ 都可以）。這樣每個點最多只能讓 1 單位流過，最大流值 = 最大點不相交路徑數。時間和 (a) 相同等級（點數變 2 倍）。

順帶一提，本例中從 1 出發的路徑都一定經過 4（2 只連到 4），所以點不相交路徑只有 1 條，程式拆點後跑最大流也得 1。這正好說明「邊不相交」和「點不相交」答案可能不同。

questions.answer: T(N) = 2T(N − 1) + c，T(1) = c ⇒ T(N) = c(2<sup>N</sup> − 1) = O(2<sup>N</sup>)
questions.explanation:
程式裡呼叫的 foo 應該就是 bar 自己（題目筆誤），這是 Tower of Hanoi（河內塔）：把 N − 1 個盤子從 X 搬到 Z、最大的從 X 搬到 Y、再把 N − 1 個從 Z 搬到 Y。

遞迴式：每次呼叫除了兩個遞迴，只做常數 c 的工作（一次比較、一次 printf）：

T(1) = c
T(N) = 2T(N − 1) + c,   N ≥ 2

展開（iteration）：

T(N) = 2T(N−1) + c
     = 4T(N−2) + 2c + c
     = 2^k T(N−k) + c(2^(k−1) + … + 2 + 1)
     = 2^(N−1) T(1) + c(2^(N−1) − 1)       （取 k = N − 1）
     = c(2^N − 1)

Substitution method 驗證：猜 T(N) ≤ d·2N − c（要減掉低階項才證得出來）。歸納：T(N) = 2T(N − 1) + c ≤ 2(d·2N−1 − c) + c = d·2N − c，成立；基底 T(1) = c ≤ 2d − c 取 d ≥ c 即可。所以 T(N) = O(2N)，而且印出的行數恰好是 2N − 1，下界也成立，其實是 Θ(2N)。

常見錯誤：直接猜 T(N) ≤ d·2N 會得到 T(N) ≤ d·2N + c，歸納失敗，要記得減一個常數。

questions.question:
（單選）Given the following graph where vertex S is the source and the weight of each edge is specified alongside the edge, please apply the Bellman-Ford algorithm. During each pass/iteration of edge-by-edge relaxation, the order of edge to be processed is: AB, AD, BC, BF, CA, CD, CE, CF, DG, EG, FG, SA, SB (i.e., lexicographic order, assuming that an edge from vertex X to vertex Y is named XY).
（原圖以有向邊列表描述，XY 表示 X → Y）
SA: 3    SB: 6    AB: 4    AD: 11   CA: 3
BC: 8    BF: 11   CD: 2    CE: 5    CF: 1
DG: 2    EG: 1    FG: 9
For this particular graph and based on the aforementioned order of edge relaxation, how many passes/iterations are required for the Bellman-Ford algorithm to converge (i.e., to correctly find shortest paths from S to each of other vertices), and what is the shortest path distance from S to G? (NOTE: The Bellman-Ford algorithm requires P passes to converge if, for every vertex, the (P+1)th pass makes no improvement in shortest path distance.)
choices: (a) 2 passes; shortest path distance from S to G = 16
(b) 2 passes; shortest path distance from S to G = 18
(c) 3 passes; shortest path distance from S to G = 16
(d) 3 passes; shortest path distance from S to G = 18
(e) 3 passes; shortest path distance from S to G = 19
questions.explanation:
所有邊權都是正的，最短距離（程式驗證）：A = 3 (S→A)、B = 6 (S→B)、C = 14 (S→B→C)、D = 14 (S→A→D)、F = 15 (S→B→C→F)、E = 19 (S→B→C→E)、G = 16 (S→A→D→G)。

依字典序處理，SA、SB 排在最後，所以：

  • 第 1 輪：前面所有邊的起點都還是 ∞，什麼都不會更新；直到最後 SA、SB 才把 A = 3、B = 6 設好。
  • 第 2 輪：AB（3 + 4 = 7 不比 6 小）、AD → D = 14、BC → C = 14、BF → F = 17、CA（17 不比 3 小）、CD（16 不比 14 小）、CE → E = 19、CF → F = 15、DG → G = 16、EG（20）、FG（24）都不比 16 小。所有距離一次到位。
  • 第 3 輪：沒有任何改進。

依題目的定義（第 P + 1 輪沒有改進就算 P 輪收斂），P = 2，S 到 G 的距離是 16（S→A→D→G = 3 + 11 + 2）。程式模擬結果相同。常見錯誤：以為走 C 那一路（S→B→C→D→G = 18）比較短。

questions.question:
（單選）Consider the same graph as in Question 7. If you can determine the order of edge relaxation, what are the minimum and maximum numbers of passes for the Bellman-Ford algorithm to converge (i.e., to correctly find shortest paths from S to each of other vertices)?（題目中的 Question 7 應指上一題的圖）
（原圖以有向邊列表描述，XY 表示 X → Y）
SA: 3    SB: 6    AB: 4    AD: 11   CA: 3
BC: 8    BF: 11   CD: 2    CE: 5    CF: 1
DG: 2    EG: 1    FG: 9
choices: (a) minimum: 1; maximum: N−1 (where N is the number of vertices in the graph)
(b) minimum: 1; maximum: N
(c) minimum: 2; maximum: N−1
(d) minimum: 2; maximum: N
(e) minimum: 3; maximum: N−1
questions.explanation:
所有邊權都是正的，最短距離（程式驗證）：A = 3 (S→A)、B = 6 (S→B)、C = 14 (S→B→C)、D = 14 (S→A→D)、F = 15 (S→B→C→F)、E = 19 (S→B→C→E)、G = 16 (S→A→D→G)。

  • 最少 1 輪：若邊的順序符合拓樸順序（這張圖沒有環），例如 SA, SB, AB, AD, BC, BF, CA, CD, CE, CF, DG, EG, FG，處理每條邊時起點的距離都已經是最終值，一輪就全部算對（程式模擬確認）。
  • 最多 N − 1 輪：Bellman-Ford 的保證是：第 k 輪之後，所有「最短路徑邊數 ≤ k」的點都正確。最短路徑最多 N − 1 條邊，所以一般圖上最多 N − 1 輪。

補充：對這張圖而言，最短路徑樹最深只有 3 條邊（例如 S→B→C→E），所以不論順序如何，3 輪內一定收斂，實際上達不到 N − 1 = 7。選項的「maximum」只能理解成一般情況的上界，所以選 (a)，標示待確認。

questions.question:
（單選）Consider the same graph as in Question 7. Which one of the following orders of edge relaxation results in the minimum number of passes for the Bellman-Ford algorithm to converge?（題目中的 Question 7 應指第 1 題的圖）
（原圖以有向邊列表描述，XY 表示 X → Y）
SA: 3    SB: 6    AB: 4    AD: 11   CA: 3
BC: 8    BF: 11   CD: 2    CE: 5    CF: 1
DG: 2    EG: 1    FG: 9
choices: (a) AB, AD, BC, BF, CA, CD, CE, CF, DG, EG, FG, SA, SB (same as in Question 7, i.e., lexicographic order)
(b) AB, AD, BC, BF, CA, CD, CE, CF, DG, EG, FG, SB, SA (reverse the last 2 edges, SA and SB, from (a))
(c) FG, EG, DG, CF, CE, CD, CA, BF, BC, AD, AB, SB, SA (reverse the first 11 edges, from (b))
(d) SB, SA, FG, EG, DG, CF, CE, CD, CA, BF, BC, AD, AB (move the last 2 edges to the top, from (c))
(e) SB, SA, AB, AD, BC, BF, CA, CD, CE, CF, DG, EG, FG (reverse the last 11 edges, from (d))
questions.explanation:
所有邊權都是正的，最短距離（程式驗證）：A = 3 (S→A)、B = 6 (S→B)、C = 14 (S→B→C)、D = 14 (S→A→D)、F = 15 (S→B→C→F)、E = 19 (S→B→C→E)、G = 16 (S→A→D→G)。

程式模擬各順序需要的輪數：(a) 2、(b) 2、(c) 3、(d) 2、(e) 1。

(e) 先處理 S 的出邊，再依 A, B, C, D, E, F 的順序處理，剛好是一個拓樸順序（S, A, B, C, D, E, F, G 中每條邊都從前指向後；CA 這條邊從 C 指回 A，但 A 的最短距離 3 已經由 SA 決定，CA 不會改善它）。處理每條邊時起點距離已經是最終值，所以一輪就收斂。

(c) 最差：出邊靠近 G 的邊排在最前面，每輪資訊只能往前推一層，需要 3 輪（最短路徑樹的最大深度）。

questions.question: （單選）Which one of the following 2-SAT problems (in conjunctive normal form, CNF) is satisfiable?
questions.explanation:
• (a) (a + b)(a + ¬b) 推出 a = 1；(¬a + b)(¬a + ¬b) 推出 a = 0，矛盾。
  • (b) (a + b)(a + ¬b) 推出 a = 1；接著 (¬a + c)(¬a + ¬c) 要求 c = 1 且 c = 0，矛盾。
  • (c) (a + b)(¬a + b) 推出 b = 1；於是 c = 1、d = 1，但 (¬c + ¬d) 要求兩者不能同時為 1，矛盾。
  • (d) b = 1，於是 c = 0、d = 0，但 (c + d) 要求至少一個為 1，矛盾。
  • (e) b = 1，c = 0、d = 0，(c + ¬d) = 0 + 1 = 1 成立；a 任意。例如 a = 0, b = 1, c = 0, d = 0，可滿足。

程式窮舉 16 種指派，只有 (e) 有解（(a, b, c, d) = (0, 1, 0, 0) 或 (1, 1, 0, 0)）。關鍵技巧：(x + y)(¬x + y) 等於直接強迫 y = 1。

questions.question:
（單選）Which one of the following statements about the implication graph for 2-SAT is true?
CNF: F = (a + b) (¬a + b) (¬b + c) (¬b + d) (¬c + ¬d)
choices: (a) The implication graph for a 2-SAT CNF is an undirected graph.
(b) There are 8 vertices and 12 edges in F's implication graph.
(c) F's implication graph is connected.
(d) There are 2 strongly connected components (SCCs) in F's implication graph.
(e) Finding SCC(s) in F's implication graph takes O(MN) time where M and N are the numbers of edges and vertices in the graph.
questions.explanation:
Implication Graph（蘊含圖）：每個變數有 x、¬x 兩個頂點；每個子句 (x + y) 產生兩條有向邊 ¬x → y 與 ¬y → x。

本題 4 個變數 → 8 個頂點；5 個子句 → 10 條邊：¬a→b、¬b→a、a→b、¬b→¬a、b→c、¬c→¬b、b→d、¬d→¬b、c→¬d、d→¬c。

  • (a) 錯：是有向圖。
  • (b) 錯：8 個頂點但只有 10 條邊。
  • (c) 對：8 個頂點全部連在一起（程式檢查，忽略方向只有 1 個連通塊）。
  • (d) 錯：程式計算 SCC 只有 1 個：b → c → ¬d → ¬b → a → b 等，8 個點互相可達。b 與 ¬b 在同一個 SCC，正好說明 F 不可滿足（與上一題 (c) 一致）。
  • (e) 錯：用 Tarjan 或 Kosaraju 找 SCC 是 O(M + N)，線性時間，這也是 2-SAT 能在線性時間解的原因。

questions.question: 5% Given a graph G=(V,E), to answer whether there is Hamiltonian Cycle in G is NP-Complete. Do you think the function f(G,u,v,k) is tractable? The function f returns yes if there is a path of length k from u to v in G, otherwise it returns no. If you think it is tractable, give me your reasons, or try to argue that the function f is not tractable.
questions.answer: 若「path」指簡單路徑：不是 tractable（NP-complete）：Hamiltonian Cycle 可以歸約到它；若允許重複點（walk），則可用矩陣乘冪或 DP 在多項式時間解。
questions.explanation:
關鍵在 path 是否要求簡單（不重複頂點）。考題通常指簡單路徑：

不 tractable（假設 P ≠ NP）：把 Hamiltonian Cycle (HC) 歸約到 f。給圖 G（n 個點），任選一點 u，對 u 的每個鄰居 v 問 f(G, u, v, n − 1)：

  • 若某個鄰居 v 回答 yes，表示有一條長度 n − 1、經過所有點的簡單路徑從 u 到 v，再加上邊 (v, u) 就是 Hamiltonian cycle。
  • 反過來，若 G 有 Hamiltonian cycle，它經過 u，拿掉 u 的其中一條邊 (u, v) 就得到 u 到 v、長度 n − 1 的簡單路徑。

最多問 deg(u) ≤ n 次，每次只是多項式時間的轉換，所以若 f 有多項式演算法，HC 也有，推得 P = NP。因此 f 是 NP-hard；又給一條路徑可以在多項式時間驗證，所以 f 是 NP-complete，不 tractable。

對照：若 path 允許重複頂點（walk），則可用 DP：Rt(x) = 「從 u 走 t 步能否到 x」，Rt+1(y) = OR over (x, y) ∈ E of Rt(x)，共 k 輪，O(k(V + E))；也可用鄰接矩陣的 k 次方（重複平方 O(n³ log k)）。這兩種解讀作答時要先講清楚。

questions.question:
（複選）This question is about the Ford-Fulkerson method. The flow and capacity is denoted as x/y on an edge, where x is the amount of flow and y is the capacity. A flow network is shown below to the left, and its corresponding residual network is show below to the right:
（左圖 flow network，以有向邊列表描述）
S → A: 9/11    S → D: 27/32   A → C: 9/10
A → D: 4/5     B → A: 4/5     D → B: 31/32
C → B: 5/7     B → C: 25/27   C → T: 29/35
B → T: 7/8
（右圖 residual network 只畫出箭頭，其中四條邊標了未知數：a 是 C → A 的邊；b 是 A → B 的邊；c 是 D → A 的邊；d 是 B → T 的邊。）
Which of the following statement(s) is(are) true?
choices: (B) b = c, a − d = 8
(C) a + b = c + 10d
questions.answer: (B)(D)（a、b、c、d 所指的邊依原圖標籤位置判讀，待確認）
questions.explanation:
Residual Network（剩餘網路）的規則：原邊 u→v 流量 f、容量 c，會產生正向剩餘邊 u→v 容量 c − f（還能再送多少），以及反向邊 v→u 容量 f（最多能退回多少）。

先確認左圖的流合法：A 進 9 + 4 = 13、出 9 + 4 = 13；D 進 27 + 4 = 31、出 31；B 進 31 + 5 = 36、出 4 + 25 + 7 = 36；C 進 9 + 25 = 34、出 29 + 5 = 34。

  • a：C → A 是 A → C（9/10）的反向邊，容量 = 流量 9。
  • b：A → B 是 B → A（4/5）的反向邊，容量 4。
  • c：D → A 是 A → D（4/5）的反向邊，容量 4。
  • d：B → T 是 B → T（7/8）的正向剩餘，容量 8 − 7 = 1。

代入：

  • (A) a − b = 5 對，但 c − d = 3 ≠ 2，整體錯。
  • (B) b = c = 4，a − d = 9 − 1 = 8，對。
  • (C) a + b = 13，c + 10d = 14，錯。
  • (D) a + b + c = 17、a + c = 13，對。

原圖中每對節點之間都有兩條方向相反的箭頭，a、b、c、d 指的是哪一條要看標籤的位置，以上依圖面判讀（待確認）。常見錯誤：把正向、反向的剩餘容量搞反，例如把 d 當成 T → B 的 7。

questions.question:
（複選）Consider the maximum flow problem in the following graph.
Let s be the source node and t be the sink node. A flow in the network is indicated by the numbers on the edges. The edge capacities are exactly the same as the flows as shown in the graph.
(For example, the number 4 on edge (s, e) represents that the flow is 4, and that the capacity is also 4, and the number x on edge (s, a) represents that the flow is x, and that the capacity is also x.)Which of the following statement(s) is (are) correct.
choices: (A) x+y+z+a+b+c = 13
(B) The value of the flow, shown in the graph, is 6.
(C) The value of the flow, shown in the graph, is 4
(D) The value of the flow, shown in the graph, is a maximum flow.
(E) The maximum flow value is 5.
questions.explanation:
第一步：用 flow conservation（流量守恆）解出六個未知數。除了 s、t 以外，每個點「流進 = 流出」：

  • a：進 x（s→a）+ 1（b→a），出 2（a→c）⇒ x = 1
  • e：進 4（s→e），出 z（e→c）+ 2（e→f）⇒ z = 2
  • c：進 2（a→c）+ z，出 y（c→s）+ 3（c→d）⇒ y = 2 + 2 − 3 = 1
  • b：進 c（d→b），出 1（b→a）+ 6（b→t）⇒ c = 7
  • d：進 3（c→d）+ a（t→d）+ 3（f→d），出 c = 7 ⇒ a = 1
  • f：進 2（e→f）+ b（t→f），出 3（f→d）⇒ b = 1

x + y + z + a + b + c = 1 + 1 + 2 + 1 + 1 + 7 = 13，(A) 對。

第二步：流量值。看 t：流進 6（b→t），流出 a + b = 2（t→d、t→f），淨流入 4。從 s 看也一樣：流出 x + 4 = 5，流回 y = 1，淨流出 4。所以這個 flow 的值是 4，(C) 對、(B) 錯。常見錯誤是只看 b→t = 6 就說流量是 6，忘了 t 還有邊往外流。

第三步：是不是最大流？每條邊都滿載，residual graph（剩餘網路）只剩反向邊。從 s 出發：s→a、s→e 滿了，但 c→s 有流量 1，可以「退掉」，所以 residual 有 s→c（1）。接著 c→a（退掉 a→c）、a→b（退掉 b→a）、b→d（退掉 d→b）、d→t（退掉 t→d，容量 1），得到 augmenting path s→c→a→b→d→t，瓶頸 1。所以流量還能加 1，現在不是最大流，(D) 錯。

加完之後流量 = 5。cut ({s}, 其餘) 的容量 = s→a 的 1 + s→e 的 4 = 5（c→s 是流進 s 的邊，不算在 cut 容量內），由 max-flow min-cut 定理，最大流不會超過 5，所以最大流就是 5，(E) 對。以上用程式（networkx 的 maximum_flow）驗算，最大流值為 5。

questions.question: （單選）Consider the following gate-level combinational logic network of a 4-bit ripple carry adder. A4A3A2A1 and B4B3B2B1 are two 4-bit input operands, Cin is the carry-in (input), S4S3S2S1 is 4-bit sum (output), and Cout is the carry-out (output).What is the number of distinct paths in this logic network? (HINT: There are 3 distinct paths to output S1, and you have to consider all of the outputs.)
questions.explanation:
把電路看成 DAG（有向無環圖）：輸入是 Ai、Bi、Cin，輸出是 S1～S4 和 Cout。要數「任一輸入到任一輸出」的路徑數，用 DP：令 N(g) = 從所有輸入走到 g 的路徑數，輸入本身 N = 1，每個閘的 N = 所有輸入線的 N 相加。照拓撲順序算一遍就好。

令第 i 級的進位輸入為 c（第 1 級是 Cin，N = 1）：

  • AND(A, B) = 1 + 1 = 2
  • AND(A, c) = 1 + N(c)
  • AND(B, c) = 1 + N(c)
  • OR（下一級進位）= 2 + 2(1 + N(c)) = 4 + 2N(c)
  • XOR（Si）= 1 + 1 + N(c) = 2 + N(c)
級N(進位輸入)Si 的路徑數OR 輸出（下一級進位）
11（Cin）36
26816
3161836
4363876（Cout）

S1 = 3 和題目提示一致。總數 = 3 + 8 + 18 + 38 + 76 = 143，選 (d)。程式列舉所有輸入到輸出的路徑，結果同樣是 143。

常見錯誤：只算到 S4、漏掉 Cout（得 67），或只算 Cout（76，接近 (a) 的 78）。路徑數每級大約翻倍，這也說明為什麼不能「列舉路徑」做時序分析，而要用 DP。

questions.question:
（單選）Consider the same logic network as in Question 10. Among all of the possible paths (from any input, to any output), the one passing through the largest number of gates (vertices) is defined as the critical path. In this particular logic network, how many gates does the critical path pass through?
（註：原卷寫 Question 10，指的是上一題第 4 題的電路，為題目筆誤。）
questions.explanation:
求 DAG 上「經過最多閘」的路徑，就是 longest path（最長路徑），一樣照拓撲順序做 DP：L(g) = 1 + max(L(輸入))，輸入的 L = 0。

每一級裡，AND 的 L = 1 + L(進位)（或 1，當輸入只有 A、B），OR 再 +1，所以「進位」每經過一級增加 2 個閘：第 1 級進位 L = 2、第 2 級 4、第 3 級 6、Cout = 8。Si 的 XOR 只比該級的進位輸入多 1：S4 = 6 + 1 = 7。

最長的是 Cin → AND → OR → AND → OR → AND → OR → AND → OR → Cout，共 8 個閘，選 (c)。程式列舉所有路徑取最大值，也是 8。這正是 ripple carry adder 慢的原因：進位鏈的長度和位元數成正比（每位 2 個閘延遲）。

questions.question:
（單選）Continue the previous question. What is the time complexity of the best/fastest algorithm for solving Question 11?
（註：原卷寫 Question 11，指的是上一題第 5 題，為題目筆誤。）
choices: (a) O(M+N) where M and N are the numbers of edges (wires) and vertices (gates)
(b) O(MlgN)
(c) O(MlgM)
(d) O(MN)
(e) O(M<sup>2</sup>)
questions.explanation:
組合邏輯電路沒有回授，是一個 DAG。DAG 上的 longest path 不必用一般圖的方法（一般圖的最長簡單路徑是 NP-hard），而是：

  1. 先做 Topological Sort（拓撲排序）：O(M + N)。
  2. 照拓撲順序，每個點 L(v) = 1 + max(L(u))，每條邊只看一次：O(M + N)。

總共 O(M + N)，選 (a)。這也就是 static timing analysis（靜態時序分析）的基本做法。常見錯誤是想到 Dijkstra 而選 O(M lg N)：Dijkstra 是求最短路徑、需要非負權重和 priority queue，用在 DAG 上反而比較慢。

questions.question:
（單選）(5 points) Consider two protein sequences A and B of lengths m and n respectively. You are tasked with implementing a dynamic programming algorithm to find the optimal global alignment between these sequences. Given the following definitions:

  • A match score of +2 for identical amino acids.
  • A mismatch penalty of −1 for different amino acids.
  • A gap penalty of −2 for each gap introduced.

Which of the following statements is correct regarding the dynamic programming solution for this alignment problem?
choices: (A) The time complexity of the algorithm is O(m + n).
(B) The space complexity of the algorithm is O(mn).
(C) The recurrence relation for the optimal alignment score S(i, j) at position (i, j) in the dynamic programming matrix is: S(i, j) = max{S(i−1, j−1)+match(A[i], B[j]), S(i−1, j)−2, S(i, j−1)−2}.
(D) The traceback procedure to reconstruct the optimal alignment always starts from the top-left corner of the dynamic programming matrix.
(E) The algorithm guarantees finding all possible optimal alignments between the two sequences.
questions.explanation:
這是 Global Alignment（全域序列比對），也就是 Needleman–Wunsch 演算法，本質和 Edit Distance（編輯距離）同一套 DP，只是把「最小成本」換成「最大分數」。

S(i, j) 代表 A[1..i] 和 B[1..j] 的最佳比對分數，最後一欄只有三種可能：A[i] 對 B[j]（match +2 或 mismatch −1）、A[i] 對空格（−2）、B[j] 對空格（−2）。邊界 S(i, 0) = −2i、S(0, j) = −2j。

  • (A) 錯：表格有 (m+1)(n+1) 格，每格 O(1)，時間 Θ(mn)，不是 O(m+n)。
  • (B) 標準做法要存整張表才能 traceback，空間 Θ(mn)，所以這句通常算對；但若只要分數，可以只留兩列做到 O(min(m, n))，Hirschberg 演算法甚至能在線性空間還原比對，因此這句是「看實作」的敘述。
  • (C) 對：正是上面三種情況取最大值，gap 每次 −2，與題目定義完全一致。
  • (D) 錯：global alignment 的 traceback 從右下角 S(m, n) 往回走到左上角 S(0, 0)；從左上角出發是搞錯方向（local alignment 則是從表中最大值出發）。
  • (E) 錯：一般 traceback 只沿一條路徑回溯，得到一個最佳比對；要列出全部最佳比對得另外記錄所有並列的來源並列舉，而且數量可能是指數級。

程式驗算：用這個遞迴式算 GATT 與 GCAT，S(4, 4) = 2，對應比對 G-ATT / GCAT-（2 − 2 + 2 + 2 − 2 = 2），遞迴式正確。

本題標示為單選，(C) 在任何情況下都成立，最符合題意，答 (C)；(B) 在「存整張表」的標準實作下也成立，官方答案（待確認）。
